name: web-tilted-testimonial-card-carousel-with-black-notched-focus-card
title: Row of slightly rotated white testimonial cards with a large black focus card that has a clipped corner, and arrow buttons below
whatItIs: A white area with overlapping rotated white quote cards with small avatars and attributions, and one taller black card at the centre with a cut top-right corner holding a larger quote, avatar and attribution in italic, with two outlined square arrow buttons under it.
whatItMeans: Lively and tactile; tilt and a dark focus card make quotes feel like pinned notes.
techniques: Make the focus card black with a clipped corner.

vocabulary.definition: The active card, larger and in a contrasting colour.
A card with one corner cut off diagonally.
A card rotated a few degrees.
Name and company below a quote.
